name: Alpha
overview: The title 'Alpha' reveals Christ's eternal nature as the beginning and the end, affirming His divine sovereignty and unchanging presence throughout all generations. Scriptures such as Isaiah 41:4 and 44:6 emphasize the Lord as the first and the last, a truth fully realized in Revelation where Christ declares Himself as Alpha and Omega, encompassing all of time and existence. This title underscores Christ's unique position as the Almighty God, who alone initiates and completes His redemptive work, offering life and hope to all who seek Him.
